01

What this covers.

This notice describes the SquatchBro Labs website and its sample-data demonstration. It does not describe the data practices of the DataMapper Pro extension, a checkout provider, or another website you choose to visit.

02

Website information.

This version of the website does not include an account sign-up, contact form, file upload, advertising script, or analytics script in its page code. The page code does not set cookies or use browser storage. Fonts and visual assets are served with the website.

Loading a website still sends connection information to the services delivering it. Hosting and network providers may process information such as an IP address, browser details, requested pages, and request times to deliver and protect the site.

03

A demo, using sample data.

The interactive mapping demo uses fictional records built into the page. Clicking “Transform sample” changes those records in your browser. The demo does not accept your files or send the sample records to a server. Reloading the page resets it.

04

Services behind the website.

GitHub and Cloudflare are involved in the website’s delivery setup. Their processing depends on which hosting, routing, and security services are active. GitHub states that GitHub Pages logs visitors’ IP addresses for security purposes.

For provider practices, see the GitHub Privacy Statement and Cloudflare Privacy Policy. Provider retention periods and controls are described by those providers.

Following an external link takes you to a service with its own privacy practices.

05

DataMapper Pro is separate.

This website notice is not an extension privacy policy. Before downloading or purchasing DataMapper Pro, review the product-specific privacy information provided with its listing and checkout.

The website demo should not be taken as a statement about extension permissions, licensing requests, payment processing, AI features, or how the released product handles your files.

06

About what you see here.

Product descriptions and demonstrations provide general information. The sample demo illustrates a workflow and is not the actual extension interface. Features, availability, and pricing may change as the product develops; review the published release information before purchasing.

Always check transformed data before using it in another system and keep a copy of your original file. Example output does not guarantee suitability for a particular integration or workflow.

References to Chrome, GitHub, Cloudflare, and other services identify those services and do not imply endorsement or affiliation.
